description: Decode tokens per second at full 262144-token context, three runs at 400 max output tokens, temperature 0.7, concurrency 1, after rebuilding llama.cpp on September 6 master.

hardware.profile: consumer desktop, DDR4 dual channel, 12 GB GPU
notes: Hybrid GDN+QSA architecture: only 12 of 48 layers carry a KV cache
262K KV at q8_0 is about 3.4 GB; GDN layers keep a fixed recurrent state
All 48 MoE expert layers on CPU (ncmoe 48); PLE n-gram table on CPU
16 decode threads, 12 batch threads, performance governor

runtime.version: master 2026-09-06 or later (includes 7 qwen4exp fixes incl. GDN normalization correction and CUDA sparse-FA)

comparison.note: The master rebuild gained speed despite raising context from 128K to 262K.

notes: Round-trip generation verified at 262K slot allocation.
Prefill, not decode, dominates wall time for long prompts.
caveats: Throughput probe only; no quality grading in this run.
